bg-tavern-night.notes: Stove left, 4 stools, calm right wall, clock top-right without numerals.

jar-joy.notes: Round globe silhouette; style authority for all jars.

mira-neutral.notes: Identity authority for Mira variants. Full-length. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved mira-neutral-r1-c2.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

kupa.notes: Six arms checked: poker, log, coal shovel, kettle, two folded. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved kupa-r1-c1.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

grandma-agrafena-kind.notes: Clock-door portrait; identity authority for grandma variants. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved grandma-agrafena-kind-r2-c2.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

bg-tavern-predawn.notes: Layout matches bg-tavern-night; cool dawn light.

mira-smile.notes: On-model with mira-neutral. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved mira-smile-r1-c1.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

mira-worried.notes: On-model with mira-neutral. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved mira-worried-r1-c1.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

mira-determined.notes: On-model; holds ladle. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved mira-determined-r1-c1.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

grandma-agrafena-whisper.notes: On-model with kind variant; hand at mouth. Real-alpha cutout re-render of approved grandma-agrafena-whisper-r1-c1.png (original had a painted checkerboard).

jar-nostalgia.notes: Jam jar with checked cloth cover.

jar-loneliness.notes: Thin tube on tall stem, one firefly.

jar-hope.notes: Teardrop with star stopper and glow; distinguished from sadness by stopper and warm glow.

jar-sediment.notes: Low flat stackable jar with dregs.

jar-empty.notes: Empty translucent globe jar; r1 rejected (contained a firefly).
